components.name: Button
components.description: Compact, bordered, semi-transparent. Grayscale filter lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #171717; color: #DCDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; cursor: pointer; filter: grayscale(0.5); transition: filter 250ms ease-out, opacity 250ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { filter: grayscale(0); background: #7F7F7F; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button Danger
components.description: Destructive action button. Deep ember background with ivory text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #640000; color: #DCDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; cursor: pointer; transition: background 250ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #800000; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #CC0000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with dark surface background and subtle border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #DCDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(220,220,210,0.4); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Inline label with semi-transparent background and subtle border.
components.css: .ds-tag { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #DCDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Container surface for sections and groups. Uses blur overlay depth.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #171717; color: #DCDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 14px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; }

components.description: Message container in the chat stream. Body text at weight 500.

narrative.overview: EmberDesk is a self-hosted LLM frontend built for users who spend hours inside the application. The design philosophy is functional warmth — a dense, low-fatigue workspace where dark surfaces are layered with blur and tint to create atmosphere, not drama. Every pixel earns its place through utility, not ornamentation. This is not a showroom. It is a well-worn desk: compact controls, information-rich surfaces, and a palette that rewards long sessions without eye strain.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric blur overlays create depth without competing with content
Semantic color is sparse and meaningful: amber for speech, green for success, red for danger
Controls are compact; density never sacrifices clarity
Every surface is configurable; the user's choices persist without friction

rules.name: The Amber Rarity Rule
rules.body: Amber is the loudest color in the default theme. It appears on quotes and emphasis only. If amber covers more than a few percent of any screen, it has been overused.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#FFF) is never used for text. Always use Ivory (#DCDCD2). Pure black (#000) is similarly avoided for surfaces — use Warm Charcoal (#171717).

rules.name: The Scalable Root Rule
rules.body: Never use fixed pixel values for font sizes. Always derive from --mainFontSize and the --fontScale multiplier.

rules.name: The Weight Restraint Rule
rules.body: Weight usage is restrained: 400 for body, 500 for labels and emphasis, 600 for sub-headings, 700 for true headings.

rules.name: The Functional Whitespace Rule
rules.body: Whitespace should exist where it aids scanning — between logically distinct groups — not as a blanket luxury margin.

rules.name: The Shell-First Rule
rules.body: Panel shells are in the initial HTML for instant first paint. Heavy inner content is deferred.

rules.name: The Blur-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is created primarily through blur overlays, not drop shadows. Box shadows are minimal and structural.

rules.name: The User-Controlled Depth Rule
rules.body: Both --blurStrength and --shadowWidth are user-configurable. Never hardcode blur or shadow values that override the user's preferences.

rules.name: The Embedded Controls Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls use 5px radius; container surfaces use 10px. This creates a subtle hierarchy: controls feel embedded within the containers they inhabit.

dos: Use blur overlays and tinted surfaces for depth — never flat solid-gray panels.
Keep interactive controls at 5px radius; reserve 10px for container surfaces.
Use opacity transitions (0.5 to 1.0) for hover states on icons and buttons.
Use the semantic color tokens consistently: amber for quotes, mint green for underlines and success, red for danger.
Derive font sizes from --mainFontSize and the --fontScale multiplier.
Provide :focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements using the theme outline color.
Keep panel shells in initial HTML for instant first paint; defer heavy inner content.
Make density a feature, not a compromise.
donts: Introduce bright or saturated accent colors beyond the established semantic set.
Use large border radii (15px+) or heavy drop shadows — they fight the atmospheric blur aesthetic.
Add decorative elements that consume vertical space without providing functional information.
Use pure white (#FFF) for text — always use Ivory (#DCDCD2).
Build a generic AI tool UI — no white backgrounds, no rounded pastel cards, no cartoon illustrations.
Build a SaaS dashboard cliché — no hero metrics, no gradient accent cards, no identical card grids.
Build a ChatGPT-like clean UI — no sterile white chat bubbles on gray.
Build a neon/cyberpunk aesthetic — no glowing borders, no neon gradients on black.
Break the ID-based DOM integration pattern with framework component abstractions.
Use fixed pixel values for font sizes.
